expectations.text: Structures the governance rules around three questions: admission, value split, and conflict resolution

expectations.text: Attributes that three-part definition of platform governance to a named source (_Platform Revolution_)

expectations.text: Assigns a named owner to each of the three governance answers

expectations.text: Checks the draft rules against the four named causes of platform market failure

expectations.text: Names all four causes: information asymmetry, externalities, monopoly power, and risk

expectations.text: Treats a market-failure cause with no rule written against it as a gap in the document

expectations.text: Maps the undisclosed data-forwarding incident to information asymmetry
